```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Install once if necessary
install.packages("readxl")
install.packages("dplyr")
install.packages("tidyr")
install.packages("sirt")
```


```{r}
# Load packages
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(sirt)
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(566)

```


```{r}
# File location
file_path <- "./data/spring_historical_english.xlsx"

# Read data
df <- read_excel(file_path)

# Look at the data
head(df)
names(df)
```

Calculate total catch for each year
```{r}
year_total_catch <- df %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    total_catch = sum(catch, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

head(year_total_catch)
```

Join total catch back to OG data
```{r}
df_proportions <- df %>%
  left_join(year_total_catch, by = "year")

head(df_proportions)
```

Calculate each stations proportion of yearly catch
```{r}
df_proportions <- df_proportions %>%
  mutate(
    proportion = catch / total_catch
  )


head(df_proportions)
```

Convert to year by station matrix
```{r}

proportion_table <- df_proportions %>%
  dplyr::select(year, tow_station, proportion) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = tow_station,
    values_from = proportion,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(year)

head(proportion_table)
```

Ensure each year sums to 1
```{r}
row_sums <- proportion_table %>%
  dplyr::select(-year) %>%
  rowSums()

summary(row_sums)
all(abs(row_sums - 1) < 1e-10)
```

Create matrix for Dirichlet Model
```{r}
proportion_matrix <- proportion_table %>%
  dplyr::select(-year) %>%
  as.matrix()

dim(proportion_matrix)
```
38 518 means we have 35 years and 518 stations

## Fit Dirichlet Model
```{r}
dirichlet_fit <- dirichlet.mle(proportion_matrix)
```

Get alpha values and put them in a dataframe
```{r}
alpha <- dirichlet_fit$alpha

alpha_table <- data.frame(
  tow_station = colnames(proportion_matrix),
  alpha = as.numeric(alpha)
)

head(alpha_table)
```


Get expected proportion for each station
E[p_i] = alpha_i / sum of all alpha
```{r}
expected_proportions <- dirichlet_fit$xsi

expected_table <- data.frame(
  tow_station = colnames(proportion_matrix),
  expected_proportion = as.numeric(expected_proportions)
)

head(expected_table)
```

Comparison:
Historical average vs fitted Dirichlet expectation
```{r}
historical_means <- colMeans(proportion_matrix)

comparison <- data.frame(
  tow_station = colnames(proportion_matrix),
  historical_mean = historical_means,
  dirichlet_mean = as.numeric(dirichlet_fit$xsi),
  alpha = as.numeric(dirichlet_fit$alpha)
)

head(comparison)
```
They should look similar but will not necessarily be the same

Check concentration param
```{r}
alpha0 <- dirichlet_fit$alpha0

alpha0
```

Tells us about the amount of variation the fitted Dirichlet has around its expected proportions.

Alpha a0 = 754.0381
This means historical proportions tend to stay relatively close to their expected proportions, rather than varying extremely widely. 

Formula: 
alpha_0 = sum of all alphas
E[p_i] = alpha_i / alpha_0



## Generate simulated years
Once the model is fitted, we can generate station-proportion vectos
```{r}
#Adjust this accordingly. Here for 1000 years
n_sim <- 1000

alpha_matrix <- matrix(
  alpha,
  nrow = n_sim,
  ncol = length(alpha),
  byrow = TRUE
)

simulated_proportions <- dirichlet.simul(alpha_matrix)
```

```{r}
dim(simulated_proportions)
```
Each row will be a possible future year.

```{r}
simulated_proportions <- as.data.frame(simulated_proportions)

colnames(simulated_proportions) <- colnames(proportion_matrix)

head(simulated_proportions)
```

Add simulation ID
```{r}
simulated_proportions <- simulated_proportions %>%
  dplyr::mutate(simulation = row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::select(simulation, everything())

head(simulated_proportions)

```

Individual station checks
```{r}
station <- "31501"

historical_min <- min(proportion_matrix[, station], na.rm = TRUE)
historical_max <- max(proportion_matrix[, station], na.rm = TRUE)

simulated_min <- min(simulated_proportions[[station]], na.rm = TRUE)
simulated_max <- max(simulated_proportions[[station]], na.rm = TRUE)

c(
  historical_min = historical_min,
  historical_max = historical_max,
  simulated_min = simulated_min,
  simulated_max = simulated_max
)
```


Write to new file
```{r}
write.csv(
  simulated_proportions,
  "simulated_dirichlet_proportions.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

## Visualisations

### Visualisation 1: One station histroical vs 10000 simulations
```{r}
# Choose a station
station <- "31501"

# Historical proportions
historical_station <- data.frame(
  proportion = proportion_matrix[, station]
)

# Simulated proportions
simulated_station <- data.frame(
  proportion = simulated_proportions[[station]]
)

# Historical min/max
historical_min <- min(historical_station$proportion, na.rm = TRUE)
historical_max <- max(historical_station$proportion, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(simulated_station, aes(x = proportion)) +
  
  # Dirichlet simulations
  geom_histogram(
    aes(fill = "Dirichlet simulations"),
    bins = 50,
    boundary = 0,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  
  # Historical minimum
  geom_vline(
    aes(
      xintercept = historical_min,
      linetype = "Historical minimum"
    ),
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  
  # Historical maximum
  geom_vline(
    aes(
      xintercept = historical_max,
      linetype = "Historical maximum"
    ),
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  
  # Historical observations
  geom_rug(
    data = historical_station,
    aes(
      x = proportion,
      colour = "Historical observations"
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    sides = "b",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Data",
    values = c("Dirichlet simulations" = "steelblue")
  ) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(
    name = "Data",
    values = c("Historical observations" = "firebrick")
  ) +
  
  scale_linetype_manual(
    name = "Historical range",
    values = c(
      "Historical minimum" = "dashed",
      "Historical maximum" = "dashed"
    )
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = paste("Historical vs Dirichlet simulations for station:", station),
    x = "Station proportion of total catch",
    y = "Number of simulations"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

Compare historical & simulated distributions across all stations
```{r}
historical_summary <- data.frame(
  tow_station = colnames(proportion_matrix),
  mean = colMeans(proportion_matrix),
  sd = apply(proportion_matrix, 2, sd),
  min = apply(proportion_matrix, 2, min),
  max = apply(proportion_matrix, 2, max)
)

simulated_summary <- data.frame(
  tow_station = colnames(simulated_proportions),
  mean = sapply(simulated_proportions, mean),
  sd = sapply(simulated_proportions, sd),
  min = sapply(simulated_proportions, min),
  max = sapply(simulated_proportions, max)
)

comparison_summary <- historical_summary %>%
  rename(
    historical_mean = mean,
    historical_sd = sd,
    historical_min = min,
    historical_max = max
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    simulated_summary %>%
      rename(
        simulated_mean = mean,
        simulated_sd = sd,
        simulated_min = min,
        simulated_max = max
      ),
    by = "tow_station"
  )
```

## VERIFYING
Use this model to predict catch in one year.
Use a set of dirichlet to simulate like 100 scenarios --> get 

### PREDICT HISTORICAL
Simulating for just one historical year
```{r}
# 1. Randomly select a historical year
selected_year <- sample(unique(df$year[df$year >= 2002]), 1)

# 2. Record the actual total catch for that year
actual_total_catch <- year_total_catch %>%
  filter(year == selected_year) %>%
  pull(total_catch)

# 3. Randomly select one row of simulated proportions
selected_simulation <- sample(seq_len(nrow(simulated_proportions)), 1)

selected_proportions <- simulated_proportions %>%
  slice(selected_simulation) %>%
  dplyr::select(-simulation)

cat("Selected historical year:", selected_year, "\n")
cat("Actual total catch:", actual_total_catch, "kg\n")
cat("Selected simulation:", selected_simulation, "\n")
```
Predict at each station
```{r}
# Convert selected proportions to a named vector
predicted_proportions <- as.numeric(selected_proportions[1, ])

names(predicted_proportions) <- colnames(selected_proportions)

# Calculate predicted catch at each station
predicted_catch <- predicted_proportions * actual_total_catch
```

Compare catch at stations
```{r}
# Actual station catches for the selected year
actual_catches <- df %>%
  filter(year == selected_year) %>%
  mutate(tow_station = as.character(tow_station)) %>%
  dplyr::select(tow_station, catch)

# Combine actual and predicted catches
comparison <- data.frame(
  tow_station = names(predicted_catch),
  predicted_catch = as.numeric(predicted_catch)
) %>%
  mutate(tow_station = as.character(tow_station)) %>%
  left_join(actual_catches, by = "tow_station") %>%
  rename(actual_catch = catch) %>%
  mutate(
    error = predicted_catch - actual_catch,
    absolute_error = abs(error),
    percentage_error = ifelse(
      actual_catch > 0,
      100 * absolute_error / actual_catch,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

# View results
head(comparison)
```

Summarise
```{r}
# Overall prediction accuracy
accuracy_summary <- comparison %>%
  summarise(
    total_actual_catch = sum(actual_catch, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_predicted_catch = sum(predicted_catch, na.rm = TRUE),
    MAE = mean(absolute_error, na.rm = TRUE),
    RMSE = sqrt(mean(error^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    mean_percentage_error = mean(percentage_error, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print(accuracy_summary)
```
```{r}
# Combine predicted and actual catches into one dataset
plot_data <- comparison %>%
  dplyr::select(predicted_catch, actual_catch) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "type",
    values_to = "catch"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    type = recode(
      type,
      predicted_catch = "Predicted Catch",
      actual_catch = "Historical Catch"
    )
  )

# Create side-by-side box plots
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = type, y = catch, fill = type)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = paste("Predicted vs Historical Station Catch —", selected_year),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Catch (kg)"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Predicted Catch" = "steelblue",
      "Historical Catch" = "darkorange"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
# Summary statistics for predicted and historical catches
catch_summary <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(type) %>%
  summarise(
    Min = min(catch, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q1 = quantile(catch, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(catch, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean = mean(catch, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3 = quantile(catch, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max = max(catch, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Print results
cat("Selected historical year:", selected_year, "\n\n")
print(catch_summary)
```

# New Testing
## Splitting into training and testing
This test evaluates performance by running different generated proportions on the same test and training set. So every simulation uses the same training years and testing years. 

Splitting
```{r}
# Restrict to the evaluation period
start_year <- 2002
end_year <- 2022

years <- sort(unique(df$year))
years <- years[years >= start_year & years <= end_year]

# Randomly select training and test years
train_years <- sample(years, 10)
remaining_years <- setdiff(years, train_years)
test_years <- sample(remaining_years, 10)

cat("Training years:\n")
print(sort(train_years))

cat("Test years:\n")
print(sort(test_years))
```

Fit dirichlet using training
```{r}
# Extract training-year proportions
train_table <- proportion_table %>%
  filter(year %in% train_years) %>%
  arrange(year)

# Convert to a matrix
train_matrix <- train_table %>%
  dplyr::select(-year) %>%
  as.matrix()

# Fit the Dirichlet distribution using training data only
dirichlet_fit <- dirichlet.mle(train_matrix)

alpha <- dirichlet_fit$alpha

# Expected station proportions
expected_proportions <- dirichlet_fit$xsi

cat("Number of training years:", nrow(train_matrix), "\n")
cat("Number of stations:", ncol(train_matrix), "\n")
```

Generate predictions:
```{r}

n_sim_per_year <- 100

# Store station predictions and accuracy metrics
all_predictions <- list()
accuracy_results <- list()

# Consistent station IDs and column order
station_ids <- colnames(train_matrix)

# Actual catches restricted to the test years
test_data <- df %>%
  filter(year %in% test_years) %>%
  mutate(tow_station = as.character(tow_station))

for (yr in sort(test_years)) {

  # Actual total catch for this test year
  actual_total <- year_total_catch %>%
    filter(year == yr) %>%
    pull(total_catch)

  # Actual catch by station
  actual_catches <- test_data %>%
    filter(year == yr) %>%
    dplyr::select(tow_station, catch)

  # Simulate station proportions from the TRAINING fit
  alpha_matrix <- matrix(
    alpha,
    nrow = n_sim_per_year,
    ncol = length(alpha),
    byrow = TRUE
  )

  simulated_props <- as.matrix(
    dirichlet.simul(alpha_matrix)
  )

  colnames(simulated_props) <- station_ids

  for (s in seq_len(n_sim_per_year)) {

    # Predict catch at each station
    predicted_catch <- simulated_props[s, ] * actual_total

    comparison <- data.frame(
      tow_station = station_ids,
      predicted_catch = as.numeric(predicted_catch)
    ) %>%
      left_join(actual_catches, by = "tow_station") %>%
      rename(actual_catch = catch) %>%
      mutate(
        year = yr,
        simulation = s,
        error = predicted_catch - actual_catch,
        absolute_error = abs(error),
        squared_error = error^2,
        percentage_error = ifelse(
          actual_catch > 0,
          100 * absolute_error / actual_catch,
          NA_real_
        )
      )

    # Store station-level results
    all_predictions[[length(all_predictions) + 1]] <-
      comparison

    # Calculate accuracy for this simulated prediction
    accuracy_results[[length(accuracy_results) + 1]] <-
      comparison %>%
      summarise(
        year = first(year),
        simulation = first(simulation),
        MAE = mean(absolute_error, na.rm = TRUE),
        RMSE = sqrt(mean(squared_error, na.rm = TRUE)),
        MAPE = mean(percentage_error, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
  }
}

# Combine all results
all_predictions <- bind_rows(all_predictions)
accuracy_results <- bind_rows(accuracy_results)

head(accuracy_results)
head(all_predictions)
```

Summarise test performance
```{r}
# Average performance for each held-out year
yearly_accuracy <- accuracy_results %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_MAE = mean(MAE, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_RMSE = mean(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_MAPE = mean(MAPE, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(yearly_accuracy)

# Overall performance across test years
overall_accuracy <- yearly_accuracy %>%
  summarise(
    mean_MAE = mean(mean_MAE, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_RMSE = mean(mean_RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_MAPE = mean(mean_MAPE, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_MAE = sd(mean_MAE, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_RMSE = sd(mean_RMSE, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print(overall_accuracy)
```

## Testing on different sets of training and tests
```{r}
# Settings
start_year <- 2002
end_year <- 2022
n_iterations <- 100
n_train <- 10
n_test <- 10
n_sim_per_year <- 100

set.seed(566)

# Ensure station IDs use consistent types
df <- df %>%
  mutate(tow_station = as.character(tow_station))

# Select eligible years
years <- sort(unique(df$year))
years <- years[years >= start_year & years <= end_year]

# Store results
accuracy_results <- list()
interval_results_list <- list()

result_index <- 1
interval_index <- 1

# Repeat the full train/test process
for (i in seq_len(n_iterations)) {

  # ----------------------------------------
  # Step 1: Select training and testing years
  # ----------------------------------------

  train_years <- sample(years, n_train)

  remaining_years <- setdiff(years, train_years)

  test_years <- sample(remaining_years, n_test)

  # ----------------------------------------
  # Step 2: Fit Dirichlet model using training
  # data only
  # ----------------------------------------

  train_table <- proportion_table %>%
    filter(year %in% train_years) %>%
    arrange(year)

  train_matrix <- train_table %>%
    dplyr::select(-year) %>%
    as.matrix()

  dirichlet_fit <- dirichlet.mle(train_matrix)

  alpha <- dirichlet_fit$alpha
  station_ids <- colnames(train_matrix)

  # ----------------------------------------
  # Step 3: Prepare testing data
  # ----------------------------------------

  test_data <- df %>%
    filter(year %in% test_years)

  # ----------------------------------------
  # Step 4: Simulate predictions for each
  # held-out year
  # ----------------------------------------

  for (yr in sort(test_years)) {

    # Actual total catch for this year
    actual_total <- year_total_catch %>%
      filter(year == yr) %>%
      pull(total_catch)

    if (length(actual_total) != 1 ||
        is.na(actual_total)) {
      next
    }

    # Actual catch at each station
    actual_catches <- test_data %>%
      filter(year == yr) %>%
      dplyr::select(tow_station, catch) %>%
      group_by(tow_station) %>%
      summarise(
        actual_catch = sum(catch, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    # ----------------------------------------
    # Step 5: Generate Dirichlet proportions
    # ----------------------------------------

    alpha_matrix <- matrix(
      alpha,
      nrow = n_sim_per_year,
      ncol = length(alpha),
      byrow = TRUE
    )

    simulated_props <- as.matrix(
      dirichlet.simul(alpha_matrix)
    )

    colnames(simulated_props) <- station_ids

    # Convert proportions to simulated catches
    simulated_catches <- simulated_props * actual_total

    # ----------------------------------------
    # Step 6: Calculate station-level
    # 95% simulation intervals
    # ----------------------------------------

    lower_95 <- apply(
      simulated_catches,
      2,
      quantile,
      probs = 0.025,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    upper_95 <- apply(
      simulated_catches,
      2,
      quantile,
      probs = 0.975,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    predicted_catches <- colMeans(simulated_catches)

    interval_results <- data.frame(
      tow_station = station_ids,
      predicted_catch = as.numeric(predicted_catches),
      lower_95 = as.numeric(lower_95),
      upper_95 = as.numeric(upper_95)
    ) %>%
      left_join(actual_catches, by = "tow_station") %>%
      mutate(
        actual_catch = replace_na(actual_catch, 0),
        absolute_error = abs(
          predicted_catch - actual_catch
        ),
        squared_error = (
          predicted_catch - actual_catch
        )^2,
        percentage_error = ifelse(
          actual_catch > 0,
          100 * absolute_error / actual_catch,
          NA_real_
        ),
        inside_interval = (
          actual_catch >= lower_95 &
          actual_catch <= upper_95
        ),
        iteration = i,
        year = yr
      )

    # Store station-level interval results
    interval_results_list[[interval_index]] <-
      interval_results

    interval_index <- interval_index + 1

    # ----------------------------------------
    # Step 7: Store overall accuracy metrics
    # for each simulated allocation
    # ----------------------------------------

    for (s in seq_len(n_sim_per_year)) {

      predicted_catch <- simulated_catches[s, ]

      comparison <- data.frame(
        tow_station = station_ids,
        predicted_catch = as.numeric(predicted_catch)
      ) %>%
        left_join(actual_catches, by = "tow_station") %>%
        mutate(
          actual_catch = replace_na(actual_catch, 0),
          absolute_error = abs(
            predicted_catch - actual_catch
          ),
          squared_error = (
            predicted_catch - actual_catch
          )^2,
          percentage_error = ifelse(
            actual_catch > 0,
            100 * absolute_error / actual_catch,
            NA_real_
          )
        )

      accuracy_results[[result_index]] <-
        comparison %>%
        summarise(
          iteration = i,
          year = yr,
          simulation = s,
          MAE = mean(absolute_error, na.rm = TRUE),
          RMSE = sqrt(
            mean(squared_error, na.rm = TRUE)
          ),
          MAPE = mean(
            percentage_error,
            na.rm = TRUE
          )
        )

      result_index <- result_index + 1
    }
  }

  if (i %% 10 == 0) {
    cat(
      "Completed iteration", i,
      "of", n_iterations, "\n"
    )
  }
}

# ----------------------------------------
# Step 8: Combine results
# ----------------------------------------

accuracy_results <- bind_rows(accuracy_results)

interval_results <- bind_rows(interval_results_list)

# ----------------------------------------
# Step 9: Summarise accuracy
# ----------------------------------------

accuracy_summary <- accuracy_results %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_MAE = mean(MAE, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_RMSE = mean(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_MAPE = mean(MAPE, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```


```{r}

# ----------------------------------------
# Step 10: Summarise 95% interval coverage
# ----------------------------------------

coverage_summary <- interval_results %>%
  summarise(
    Total_predictions = n(),
    Coverage = mean(inside_interval, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    Mean_interval_width = mean(
      upper_95 - lower_95,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    Lower_2.5th_percentile = quantile(
      lower_95, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    Upper_97.5th_percentile = quantile(
      upper_95, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

# Display results
accuracy_summary
coverage_summary
```

```{r}
# Combine results
accuracy_results <- bind_rows(accuracy_results)

head(accuracy_results)
```

```{r}
# Average simulations for each test year and iteration
yearly_accuracy <- accuracy_results %>%
  group_by(iteration, year) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_MAE = mean(MAE, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_RMSE = mean(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_MAPE = mean(MAPE, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Average performance across the 10 test years
iteration_accuracy <- yearly_accuracy %>%
  group_by(iteration) %>%
  summarise(
    MAE = mean(mean_MAE, na.rm = TRUE),
    RMSE = mean(mean_RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    MAPE = mean(mean_MAPE, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Overall performance across all 100 iterations
overall_accuracy <- iteration_accuracy %>%
  summarise(
    mean_MAE = mean(MAE, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_MAE = sd(MAE, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_RMSE = mean(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_RMSE = sd(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_MAPE = mean(MAPE, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_MAPE = sd(MAPE, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print(overall_accuracy)
```
